artisticChange: Only spatial phase selection and rock texture anisotropy change. No new assets, no texture-byte changes, no added global recolor, no geometry changes. Existing exposed-rock color calibration retained identically.
candidateSampling: Three translated, unrotated source samples per triangular cell, sharpened barycentric weights power6. Same phase/weights/UV gradients for albedo, normal and ARM. Original triplanar axis conventions unchanged.
filtering: Rock-only anisotropy1 avoids observed native ANGLE/Mesa flat-mip rows at phase boundaries. Other texture anisotropy remains4. This changes grazing-angle filtering quality; not validated across browser/mobile GPUs.
